name: Vendor invoice approval gate (AI agent + exception queue)

parameters.formDescription: Paste an invoice line. The agent extracts the fields, checks the approved-supplier record and either files it or sends it to a person.

options.systemMessage: You adjudicate supplier invoices against a policy record that is supplied to you. Never invent a vendor, amount, category or limit. Reply with one minified JSON object and nothing else, keys: vendor, amount, currency, category, decision ("approved" or "needs_review"), reason, confidence (0-1), policy_found (boolean).

parameters.subject: =Approval needed: {{ $json.vendor }} - {{ $json.amount }} {{ $json.currency }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ run_id: $json.intake_id, tool: 'file_invoice_override', payload: { invoice: { vendor: $json.vendor, amount: $json.amount, currency: $json.currency, invoice_ref: $json.invoice_ref }, reason: $json.reason }, callback_url: 'http://127.0.0.1:5678/webhook/shotty-decision', title: $json.vendor + ' — ' + $json.amount + ' ' + $json.currency, fields: [ { label: 'Vendor', value: $json.vendor }, { label: 'Amount', value: $json.amount + ' ' + $json.currency }, { label: 'Approved limit', value: $json.approved_limit === null ? 'no approved-supplier record' : String($json.approved_limit) }, { label: 'Why held', value: $json.reason } ] }) }}

meta.description: AI agent adjudicates supplier invoices against a deterministic policy record, then either files the invoice or routes it to a human exception queue. Model approval is checked against policy before it is accepted; failures are written to an error queue.
